programme.desc: 'S5/E4 - Imposters Italiano'. Valerie Bertinelli and Duff Goldman challenge the kid bakers to make meat, spinach and mushroom or veggie-Pesto lasagne to get to the final round.

programme.title: Kitchen Undercover
programme.desc: 'S1/E1 - Broke Spirits'. Antonia and Nestor go undercover in a once-booming BBQ joint that is about to go bust if they can't clean up the kitchen and the staff's attitudes.

programme.title: Kitchen Undercover
programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - The San Pedro Sting'. With Antonia's help, the struggling San Pedro Brewing Company must reinvigorate recipes and inspire their apathetic staff for a shot at redemption.

programme.title: Kitchen Undercover
programme.desc: 'S1/E3 - True Gritz'. Gritz N' Wafflez rapidly went from ghost kitchen to booming hot spot. Now, this soul food restaurant must clean up the chaos before it collapses.

programme.title: Baking Championship: Next Gen
programme.desc: 'S1/E6 - Cream Puff Craze'. The sibling teams create cream puff friendship bracelets arranged in two circles, like a pair of bracelets, decorated with messages to each other.

programme.title: Baking Championship: Next Gen
programme.desc: 'S1/E7 - Bigs and Littles'. On each baking team, the older sibling makes one big dessert while the younger sibling makes a dozen little desserts.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S34/E16 - Tacos, Tots And Chops'. Guy Fieri's enjoying a real deal Reuben in Grand Junction, Colorado, next-level tacos in Salt Lake City and Middle Eastern specialties in Nashville.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S34/E17 - Classic And Comfort'. Guy Fieri's comfort-filled joy ride takes him to Draper, Utah, for fried chicken and grits and then heads to Nashville for vegan chorizo.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S34/E18 - From Europe To Asia'. Guy finds righteous ramen in Millcreek, Utah, artichoke parmesan soup in Grand Junction, Colorado, and stuffed cabbage and schnitzel in Albuquerque, New Mexico.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S1/E7 - Nola'. New Orleans' vibrant cuisine is a fusion of culinary influences. Andrew explores the city's classic dishes from po' boys and gumbo to oysters Rockefeller.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S1/E8 - St. Louis'. As the Gateway to the West, St. Louis has built a reputation for homegrown goodness. Andrew explores such edible icons as toasted ravioli and gooey butter cake.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S4/E7 - Taipei'. Andrew explores the edible icons of Taipei, Taiwan, a place where the dumplings can be dangerous and who you share the meal with is as important as the meal itself.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S4/E8 - Ho Chi Minh City'. Andrew unveils the cuisine of Ho Chi Minh City, the economic and cultural centre of Vietnam. The city has a rich history and the food lives up to its legacy.

programme.title: Chopped Castaways
programme.desc: 'S1/E4 - Choose Your Weapon'. The teams must choose their weapons and hit their targets to earn high-value ingredients. In a relay-style cook, each team creates one cohesive dish.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S56/E8 - Friendsgiving'. Celebrating the trendy tradition of hosting a Friendsgiving meal, four teams of best buddies compete to make the ultimate Thanksgiving feast.

programme.title: Diana Chan's Malaysia
programme.desc: 'S1/E3 - Coastal Harvests'. Diana hits Malaysia's coast, exploring the country's love for seafood, diving into the bold flavours and techniques behind its most-loved dishes.

programme.title: Diana Chan's Malaysia
programme.desc: 'S1/E2'. Chef, cookbook author and foodie Diana Chan goes back to her roots in an upbeat trip across Malaysia to explore the country's rich culinary identity.

programme.title: Delicious Miss Brown
programme.desc: 'S6/E11 - Shaking Up Soul Food'. Kardea takes on the challenge of making vegan soul food. She makes dishes like lemon-pepper fried 'chicken' tenders and vegan baked mac and cheese.

programme.title: Delicious Miss Brown
programme.desc: 'S6/E12 - Mosquito Beach Dinner'. Kardea hosts a dinner to celebrate a significant place in Charleston's Gullah history. West African peanut stew and stuffed whole snapper are on the menu.

programme.desc: 'S1/E5 - Over-the-Top Day'. The competition's first $20,000 prize winner is back to battle Michelle Wallace and Adam Greenberg in making Flavortown's boldest over-the-top dishes.

programme.title: Girl Meets Farm
programme.desc: 'S15/E5 - Cookbook Club Potluck'. For her cookbook club, Molly Yeh puts her own twists on a Midwestern hotdish, two very different salads and a caramel-filled treat.

programme.title: Spring Baking Championship

programme.desc: 'S1/E48'. Khaya deals with being home and urges Phiwe to break it off with the Mngunis now that he's home. Thando's online persona Felix matches with Lihle on Shela.

programme.title: The Four Of Us
programme.desc: 'S1/E93'. Despite warnings to slot down, Balungile rushes headfirst into love as Vera fights for Madimetja's freedom, while Mnini earns a prestigious opportunity that sparks jealousy.

programme.title: eGagasini - Waves Of Change
programme.desc: 'S1/E93'. After a fatal accident on a yacht, a rising 3-Step trio with a viral hit, covers up the murder to secure a life-changing record deal, only to discover the victim was the only daughter of the music mogul.

programme.title: Durban Gen
programme.desc: 'S1/E79 - 1/79'. Mbali deals with the repercussions of her insubordination and finds herself attending a hearing. Precious wants a baby and everything in the hospital makes her want it even more.

programme.title: Rhythm City
programme.desc: 'S1/E118'. The battle between the real power brokers of the music industry: the record companies, promoters, producers, DJs and the stars - but also the wannabe stars, the has-beens, families and lovers.

programme.title: Twist of Fate
programme.desc: 'S3/E84'. Pragya notices Simonika's lookalike travelling in a car. She follows her but fails to reach her. She informs Purab and Abhi about it. Abhi becomes hopeful, but Purab warns him that Pragya might be imagining it out of stress.

programme.title: India: A Love Story
programme.desc: 'S1/E143'. Showing the great differences between the cultures of India and Brazil, the story focuses on the forbidden passion between two very different Indians of origin.

programme.title: Lente Na Die Storm
programme.desc: 'S2/E11'. Rengin files a complaint against Bahar. Efsun tries to persuade Selen not to go through with the pregnancy.

programme.title: Vlymskerp
programme.desc: 'S1/E52'. Daghan is faced with a fresh challenge from Korkut. Leyla wants to meet Korkut face to face. Nilufer wants to get away from Kurt and Meester.

programme.title: Bittersoet
programme.desc: 'S2/E23'. Vildan makes a shocking discovery when she reads Nihan's journal. Kemal puts a complicated plan in action, allowing Nihan to hear Ozan's final phone calls, but can she handle it?

programme.title: Sout van die Aarde
programme.desc: 'S2/E33'. Kenan is still trying to find his biological parents. The wedding preparations for Taner and Dilek are underway, and Dilek is upset because her family members can't attend the wedding.

programme.title: Entertainment Set
programme.desc: Entertainment highlights, news and reviews.

programme.title: Yosef
programme.desc: 'S2/E112'. After wavering, Duygu decides not to quit her job, leading Ali to believe he should act as if nothing happened between them.

programme.title: 'n Ma se Hart
programme.desc: 'S1/E32 - 1/32'. Kadir discovers Seher's lie and erupts in anger. Yaman reopens Melike's case. Haluk imprisons Berrin, determined to uncover the truth.

programme.title: Op 'n Afgrond
programme.desc: 'S1/E31'. Seyfi arrives in Cappadocia seeking Nuh and Melek over an inheritance, as Enise reveals she and Sumru were kicked out, prompting concern and support.

programme.title: Lente Na Die Storm
programme.desc: 'S2/E12'. Bahar learns a skill in jail. Efsun has a plan to convince Selen to get an abortion. Rengin gives Timur an ultimatum. A mysterious young man is admitted with a stab wound.

programme.title: Vlymskerp
programme.desc: 'S1/E53'. Leyla confronts Korkut. Ruzgar asks Enver for help. Daghan faces Korkut for a last battle.

programme.title: Die Put
programme.desc: 'S1/E39'. Sena finally stands up for herself while Yamac and Alico desperately try to find who murdered Feyaz's son.
